_what: Make the HVAC chain fast at RUNTIME instead of in the source. ValveCycleTime, MIN_ONTIME and MIN_OFFTIME are plain VAR members that only FB_init assigns, so a write after download sticks - and this sidesteps the fact that changing an FB_init ARGUMENT from a script does not reach the compiler at all (see CLAUDE.md).
_better: It is also the safer arrangement: the source keeps the production minutes, so there is no way to accidentally ship 5-second valve travel to an installation with real pipes.

steps.label: shrink the timings at runtime, and prove the writes actually stuck
and make the sensor trustworthy so a thermostat can call for heat at all
